description:
Create a standardized A3 landscape drawing template in LibreCAD. 

Goal: Create a new drawing saved as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/a3_template.dxf' with the following specifications:

1. Layer Setup:
   - Create 3 layers: 'Border' (White), 'TitleBlock' (Cyan), 'Text' (Green).

2. Borders (on 'Border' layer):
   - Outer Paper Border: Rectangle from (0,0) to (420,297).
   - Inner Margin: Rectangle from (10,10) to (410,287).

3. Title Block (on 'TitleBlock' layer):
   - Main Box: Rectangle from (240,10) to (410,50).
   - Horizontal Divider: Line from (240,30) to (410,30).
   - Vertical Divider: Line from (325,10) to (325,30).

4. Text Annotations (on 'Text' layer, approx height 5mm):
   - 'RESIDENTIAL FLOOR PLAN' centered in the top row of the title block.
   - 'Drawn: A. Torres' in the bottom-left cell.
   - 'Scale: 1:50' in the bottom-right cell.
